evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo framing — the rep actually quoted a price range ('our hourly rate is $190, it's good to budget around $475 to $570') before gathering almost any move details at all, a process-order violation.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: 'that's pretty pricey though for just a small one bedroom' and repeated questions about the wall-mounted TV, remounting, and whether $475 was the final straight cost — the rep engaged each objection directly across multiple turns with specifics, scored full credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the Save Your Ass lines were delivered — no 'this is just an estimate' framing, no beats-it-pay-less line, no self-prep tip, no fairness check.

top_strength: Stayed patient and factual through a skeptical, price-sensitive customer's repeated questions about the flat rate and what was/wasn't included.
coaching_note: Gave a price estimate before doing discovery (backwards from the script), and the damage-coverage, Meet-Your-Mover, and On-Time/Communication differentiators were never delivered at all in this call.
